{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|arg= global

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Return the provided player's unique Cloud service account id.

|mp= {{Feature|important|Only works in multiplayer and on official servers.}}

|s1= [[getPlayerCloudId]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - the player unit from whom to obtain the Cloud ID

|r1= [[String]] - the Cloud ID or empty string if in single player or if ''unit'' is not a live player unit

|x1= <sqf>
_localPlayerCloudID = getPlayerCloudId player;
_remotePlayerCloudID = getPlayerCloudId _otherPlayer;
_emptyString = getPlayerCloudId objNull;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getPlayerUID]] [[getPlayerUIDOld]]
}}
